name: Maldives
tagline: Top-tier incentive trips for small groups
intro: The strongest reward signal available for a small, high-performing group. One resort island means the group is together for the whole trip, which is either exactly what you want or the reason to choose somewhere else.
access: Direct flights from Delhi, roughly four hours, then a seaplane or speedboat transfer.
highlights: Reads as a genuine prize in a way few destinations do, which is the entire purpose of an incentive trip.
A single resort island keeps a small group together without any internal logistics.
Short flight relative to how far away it feels.
planning_note: Cost per delegate is the highest on this list and resort capacity caps group size hard — most properties cannot take a large group at all. Seaplane transfers only run in daylight, so arrival timing drives the whole itinerary.
